subject: Urgent: initial IR notice + request for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ artifacts
messages:
From: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@greengrid.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: support+sec@greengrid.io
Date: 2028-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security incident: anomalous API activity - initial notice

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Quick heads up from our security team: between 07:40–08:05 PST this morning we saw a sharp spike in token usage for our integration (org: GreenGrid Health). The activity appears to correlate with a new SaaS connector we enabled yesterday. We’ve isolated the calls to a small set of client keys and are containing by rotating the affected keys.

Can Redwood share your incident response plan (IRP) for production API anomalies and any SIG/CAIQ snapshot or SOC 2 evidence you can provide for customer review? Our compliance team needs a short artefact bundle to evaluate risk and retention implications — ideally the IRP summary, point-of-contact roster, and relevant telemetry retention statements.

We'd appreciate the material by EOD tomorrow (Jan 19) if possible. If you prefer a quick call, we can make time at 11:30 PST today.

Thanks,
Carmen Ruiz
Head of Security, GreenGrid Health
--
Carmen Ruiz
GreenGrid Health
C: +1 415-555-0134
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@greengrid.io>
Date: 2028-01-18T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security incident: anomalous API activity - initial notice

Thanks for the alert, Carmen — and sorry for the interruption. Ben / Karthik / Marissa, looping you in to confirm containment and evidence handoff.

Immediate asks:
- Ben: please confirm whether the spike was a product-side behavior (routing/billing key reuse) or an upstream client activity.
- Karthik: can you prepare a short IRP excerpt (1–2 pages) that covers containment steps, POC roster, and notification cadence for customers? Include the procedure we use to rotate API keys and preserve telemetry.
- Marissa: please coordinate a sanitized telemetry bundle (logs with PII redacted) and a SIG/CAIQ snapshot we can hand to GreenGrid. Carmen asked for SOC 2-relevant evidence too — if we can provide our SOC 2 scope statement and the relevant control owners that would help.

Carmen — we can share an onboarding bundle and a short postmortem summary. I want to be clear: at this stage we are treating this as an integration-triggered spike, not a confirmed platform compromise. We'll keep you updated as we validate.

I can do the 11:30 PST call — Marissa, please send a calendar invite if that works.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@greengrid.io>
Date: 2028-01-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security incident: anomalous API activity - initial notice

On Wed, Jan 18, 2028 at 09:40 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the alert, Carmen — and sorry for the interruption. Ben / Karthik / Marissa, looping you in to confirm containment and evidence handoff.

Quick summary from infra: we sampled the request ids Carmen shared and traced the traffic to a connector instance in GreenGrid's account that began replaying a warm cache loop after the connector retry logic kicked in. No sign of credential exfiltration or anomalous tokens outside that connector. We rotated the affected keys at 09:02 PST (GreenGrid already rotated on their side).

I'll assemble:
- a 1-page incident summary (timeline + containment)
- a sanitized telemetry extract (timestamps, request_id, route, token-hash; no user PII)

Karthik — please attach the IRP excerpt and SIG/CAIQ snapshot; Marissa: can you produce the sanitized logs and the SOC 2 scope statement?

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: telemetry_sample_20280118.log (log/plain), incident_timeline_20280118.txt (text)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@greengrid.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-19T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Final: IRP excerpt, SIG/CAIQ snapshot, and sanitized postmortem (GreenGrid)

Carmen — thanks for the call earlier. Per our conversation, attached is the bundled material for GreenGrid's compliance review. High level: containment completed within 30 minutes of detection; root cause traced to a connector retry loop in the customer's integration that caused disproportionate prefix caching and request amplification. No unauthorized access to Redwood control plane or key vaults.

Attachments included (sanitized):
- ir_playbook_v2.pdf — excerpted IRP: detection, escalation POC, containment checklist, and customer notification timelines.
- sig_caiq_snapshot.zip — SIG/CAIQ answers (current snapshot for customer review).
- sanitized_postmortem_redacted.pdf — 2-page postmortem focused on timeline, root cause, and recommended mitigations for connector authors.
- telemetry_sample_20280118.log — redacted request sample (request_id, route, timestamp, token-hash).

Related links: shared Drive folder with expanded telemetry and our SOC 2 scope document: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link (read-only). HubSpot record for this engagement: TICKET-48291.

Next steps / asks from GreenGrid: please confirm whether your remediation team will adopt the connector retry limiter we discussed and whether you need a formal attestation letter for your audit. If GreenGrid's compliance team requires a signed SOC 2 bridge letter, let us know and we'll route to legal for approval (this may take 3–5 business days).

If you want any additional redactions prior to sharing with auditors, say the word and we'll produce an auditor-friendly bundle.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
--
Hannah Schmitt
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ir_playbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf), sig_caiq_snapshot.zip (application/zip), sanitized_postmortem_redacted.pdf (application/pdf), telemetry_sample_20280118.log (text/plain)
